scenario.description: A plant manager must authorize and control a hot-work repair on an overhead crane above the fabrication area, deciding the production stoppage and fire-prevention requirements with input from a maintenance engineer and an environmental health and safety officer.

shared_context.S1: The overhead crane above the fabrication area has a cracked mounting bracket that must be repaired by welding before the next high-load lift.
shared_context.S2: The fabrication area is scheduled to produce steel frames during tomorrow's day shift.
shared_context.S3: The crane repair is classified as hot work and requires a documented work authorization before welding begins; plant practice allows Elena to issue the authorization during the pre-job review provided the permit is filed and all controls are in place before welding starts.
shared_context.S4: The plant's routine pre-job review requires Elena to check the work scope, production impact, and safety controls with maintenance and environmental health and safety before issuing the authorization.
shared_context.S5: Before Elena closes the pre-job review, Ravi and Monique must each enter their reviewed finding into the formal review record.
shared_context.S6: The completed hot-work authorization record must be filed before welding begins, and the permit record documents the work scope, approval, and controls.

PF1.text: Ravi's engineering assessment specifies that the bracket repair requires exactly 4 hours of crane lockout and fabrication-area stoppage; he completed the assessment from the repair contractor's work package yesterday, but the maintenance work order still shows only an unconfirmed duration.

PF2.text: Monique's permit review specifies that this weld location requires a two-person fire watch, atmospheric testing every 2 hours, and a 15-meter exclusion boundary for combustible materials; she confirmed these requirements against the site's hot-work standard this morning, but the permit draft has not yet been filed.

acceptance_conditions: The hot-work repair must be authorized.
The crane must be locked out during the repair.
The fabrication area must be stopped for exactly 4 hours.
Atmospheric testing must be scheduled every 2 hours.
The work must have a two-person fire watch.
Combustible materials must be kept outside a 15-meter boundary.
A hot-work permit filing commitment must be recorded with type "permit_filing" or "file_permit".
The maintenance duration finding must be cited as justification.
The safety-control finding must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'permit_filing' or c['type'] == 'file_permit' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The engineering assessment changes the repair plan from an unspecified interruption to mandatory crane lockout and exactly 4 hours of fabrication stoppage, and supplies the maintenance fact Elena must cite.

The hot-work standard changes the controls to atmospheric testing every exactly 2 hours, a two-person fire watch, and a 15-meter combustible-material boundary, and requires the permit-filing commitment and cited safety finding.
